title: Transcribe a recording
summary: Writes down the words in an audio file on this device with Apple's on-device speech model.
whenToUse: Use when the person has a recording (a voice memo, an interview, a lecture) and wants its words.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: The recording the person picked (a file on this device)

arguments.name: language
arguments.description: The language spoken, such as en-US or es-ES; the device's language when empty

example: Transcribe this recording and save the text to AI Write
